subject: p-fc
title: (R)P.FC.------POL.P.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-5 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One) opening Braxton's central frame for the chapter: the sixties activism analysis. 'The vibrational platform that solidified in the sixties would establish the first real move towards alternative functionalism for the post–World War Two generation.' (R)P-FC (the reality of particular focus) is crossed with POL-P (political policies): the question is what particular-focus produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with political-policies. EXT-INFO (extended information) branches from the main line and leads to MT-INFO (multi-information), which carries TRS (transition). POL-P sits at the upper-right. OP-SPD (option-spread) also branches from the main line and leads to SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics), then to POST (postulation) and on to CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). The diagram exposes Braxton's structural diagnostic of sixties activism: real particular-focus crossed with political-policies produces option-spread (multiple alternative paths) and feeds into culture-solidification through postulation and social-reality-dynamics.
